delete.body: This deletes your progress on this device: coins, levels, settings and unrestored purchases. Purchases can be recovered with Restore purchases.

fair.rule1: Pieces come from a seeded generator. The seed is shown at the end of every game.
fair.rule2: The generator never knows whether you watched ads, bought anything, your country or your phone. It is separated from the ad system by design and a test checks it.
fair.rule3: Every new tray has at least one piece that fits your patio.
fair.rule4: Never more than two identical pieces in a row.
fair.rule5: Difficulty only rises with your score, following the public table below, the same for everyone.
fair.rule6: A game ends only when truly no piece fits: every cell is checked.
fair.rule7: The daily challenge uses the same seed for everyone that day.
